description: Header file defining testing utilities for hash generators in the Abseil C++ library, including random value generators for various types and internal type traits.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: Template struct for generating random values of various types, specialized for integral types, enums, strings, pairs, tuples, unique pointers, and types with key/value members.

classes.name: UniqueGenerator
classes.description: Template wrapper that generates unique values by linear search, limited to a maximum number of values.

methods.name: GetSharedRng
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a shared 64-bit Mersenne Twister random number generator.

methods.name: operator() (for Generator classes)
methods.description: Generates a random value of the specified type.

methods.name: operator() (for UniqueGenerator)
methods.description: Generates a unique value not previously generated by this instance.
